Render a 3D DICOM Volume (Orthogonal MPR, MIP, or Interactive rgl 3D)

Source: R/volume.R
render_volume.Rd

Visualizes a 3D DICOM series ("dicom_series" or 3D numeric array) using:

  • "mpr": 3-plane Orthogonal Multi-Planar Reconstruction (Axial, Coronal, Sagittal slices) via ggplot2.

  • "mip": Maximum Intensity Projection across Axial, Coronal, and Sagittal orientations via ggplot2.

  • "rgl": Interactive 3D voxel rendering using the rgl package (falls back to "mip" if rgl is not installed).

Usage

render_volume(
  x,
  method = c("mpr", "mip", "rgl"),
  window = "auto",
  threshold = 0.5,
  palette = c("gray", "viridis", "inferno", "magma", "plasma")
)

Arguments

x

A "dicom_series" object (from read_dicom_series()), a 3D numeric array [rows, cols, slices], or a directory/vector of DICOM file paths.

method

Visualization mode: "mpr" (default), "mip", or "rgl".

window

Window preset ("auto", "brain", "lung", "bone", etc.) or c(center, width). Default is "auto".

threshold

Optional intensity threshold in [0, 1] for 3D "rgl" point-cloud / surface rendering. Default is 0.5.

palette

Color palette ("gray", "viridis", "inferno", "magma", "plasma"). Default is "gray".

Value

A ggplot2::ggplot object (for "mpr" and "mip") or invisibly the rgl scene ID (for "rgl").

Examples

dcm_file <- system.file("extdata", "example.dcm", package = "dicomtk")
series <- read_dicom_series(c(dcm_file, dcm_file, dcm_file))
render_volume(series, method = "mpr")

render_volume(series, method = "mip")
